# Lap of Love

> > Lap of Love provides compassionate in-home pet euthanasia, veterinary hospice, and grief support services for senior and terminally ill pets.

Lap of Love is a national provider of end-of-life veterinary care services, specializing in in-home euthanasia and hospice care for aging pets. The organization combines medical expertise with emotional support through virtual grief counseling, memorial services, and educational resources for pet owners navigating difficult end-of-life decisions.

## Key Topics

- In-Home Euthanasia
- Veterinary Hospice
- Pet Loss Support
- End-of-Life Care
- Quality-of-Life Assessment
- Symptom Management
- Pet Grief Counseling
- Geriatric Pet Care
- Dog Diseases
- Cat Diseases
- Pet Aftercare
- Telehospice
- Pet Memorials
- Veterinary Resources

## Core Services

- [In-Home Euthanasia](https://www.lapoflove.com/our-services/in-home-euthanasia): In-home euthanasia service providing compassionate end-of-life care for pets.
- [Veterinary Hospice](https://www.lapoflove.com/our-services/veterinary-hospice): Veterinary hospice care service for managing pet symptoms and quality of life.
- [Telehospice](https://www.lapoflove.com/our-services/telehospice): Remote veterinary consultation service for elderly and terminally ill pets.
- [Aftercare Services](https://www.lapoflove.com/our-services/aftercare): Pet cremation and aftercare options including home burial and memorial services.
- [Pet Loss Support](https://www.lapoflove.com/our-services/pet-loss-support): Free weekly virtual pet loss support groups and grief counseling sessions.

## Educational Resources

- [How Will I Know It's Time](https://www.lapoflove.com/how-will-i-know-it-is-time): Guide using Quality-of-Life Scale to help determine when euthanasia is appropriate.
- [Quality-of-Life Assessment Tool](https://www.lapoflove.com/quality-of-life-assessment): Interactive Quality-of-Life assessment tool to evaluate pet wellness and care.
- [Common Diseases in Dogs](https://www.lapoflove.com/resource-center/common-diseases-in-dogs): Guide to common dog diseases and symptom management for senior pets.
- [Common Diseases in Cats](https://www.lapoflove.com/resource-center/common-diseases-in-cats): Guide to common cat diseases and symptom management for senior pets.
- [Symptom Management](https://www.lapoflove.com/resource-center/symptom-management): Resource guide for managing symptoms in aging pets and geriatric care.
- [Video Library](https://www.lapoflove.com/videos): Video library on senior pet care, diseases, and symptom management.

## Pet Loss & Grief Support

- [Pet Loss Support Resource Center](https://petloss.lapoflove.com): Pet loss support blog with articles, videos, and grief counseling resources.
- [Blog](https://www.lapoflove.com/blog): Senior pet care blog covering diseases, symptom management, and end-of-life care.
- [Pet Memorials](https://www.lapoflove.com/pet-memorial): Searchable pet memorial collection where users light virtual candles for lost pets.
- [Pet Memorial Keepsakes](https://info.lapoflove.com/keepsakes): Hand-picked pet memorial keepsakes and cremation jewelry products.

## Veterinary Resources

- [Veterinary Resource Center](https://www.lapoflove.com/veterinary-resource-center): End-of-life care tools, hospice protocols, and business resources for veterinarians.
- [Clinic Resources](https://info.lapoflove.com/clinic-resources): Veterinary clinic resources including brochures, protocols, and service areas.

## Support & Information

- [Home](https://www.lapoflove.com): Lap of Love homepage showcasing in-home pet euthanasia and end-of-life care services.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.lapoflove.com/faq): FAQ on in-home euthanasia, hospice, aftercare, and grief support services.
- [Newsletter](https://www.lapoflove.com/newsletter): Senior Pet Digest monthly newsletter on geriatric pet care and pet loss support.
